SessionEnd.description: cost-tracker-notion: logs session token usage and estimated cost to a Notion cost-tracking database
notion-session-log: writes a session summary entry to a Notion database for audit and review
daily-digest-slack: sends a structured session digest to a designated Slack channel
zapier-webhook: fires a Zapier webhook with the session payload for downstream automation routing
n8n-webhook: fires an n8n webhook with the session payload for self-hosted workflow automation
